info.text:
In 2018, vanilla hit about $600 a kilo, more than silver (about $505 a kilo that year).

Every vanilla flower is pollinated by hand on the one day it opens; pods ripen about 9 months, then cure for months.
Madagascar grew about 42% of the world's vanilla in 2023; a 2017 cyclone there sent prices soaring.
After Madagascar dropped its $250/kg export floor in May 2023, its exports averaged about $47/kg in early 2024.
Example (hypothetical, beans only): a gallon of US-standard extract needs 13.35 oz of beans: $227.08 at $600/kg vs $17.79 at $47/kg.
Less than 1% of vanilla flavor comes from real beans.

Sources: BBC (2018); USGS/Silver Institute (2018 silver avg); FAOSTAT via Choices (AAEA); Mintec (2023); Bloomberg (Aug 2024); 21 CFR 169; C&EN (ACS).
News and education, not financial advice.
